newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot Oct gas prices hold steady, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot Oct gas prices hold steady, trade thin.

text.p: U.S. spot natural gas prices for October notionally held steady Thursday, but with bidweek now over, many opted for the sidelines until next week when October flows begin, industry sources said.
While Oct baseload quotes were unchanged from Wednesday, some said early-month gas seemed well-offered, a factor that could pressure prices near-term without colder weather.
"There are a lot of people offering swing gas for early October," said one cash trader.
October Gulf Coast gas was still pegged in the low-to-mid $1.80s/mmBtu, more than five cents over September indices.
September gas at the Gulf firmed a couple of cents this morning to the low-to-mid $1.90s.
October Midcon gas was talked up slightly but still in the low-to-mid $1.70s, almost 10 cents over Sept indices.
In south Texas, gas for October delivery was unchanged in the mid-to-high $1.70s, steady to slightly over index.
West Texas October gas on El Paso Permian gained a couple of cents to the high-$1.60s, still a few cents below Sept 1 levels.
October New York city gate gas jumped about five cents to the $2.15 area.
